title: AI-generated night renderings: five red lights over desert road; blue van-like shape
description: Two uncaptioned AI-generated night scenes, on the page between the "Incident 2" and "Incident 3" images. The top image shows five red lights in a row above the horizon at left and a bright white light at the end of a curving dirt road, under the Milky Way. The bottom image shows a mountain range under a starry sky, a dirt road curving away at right and a small blue-outlined, van-like shape on the desert floor at left. Marked UNCLASSIFIED, page 7.
